title: Lisa Brennan-Jobs (writer, 'Small Fry' author) on Incorruptible — 'A much needed idealism-restorative for our times'
summary: Lisa Brennan-Jobs — writer, author of the memoir Small Fry — leaves a 5-star Amazon review on launch day.
